emma_cs: Quick heads-up — BlueMarble hosted commit is $15,000/month. billing-bot just flagged a weekly spike: burn this week $6.2k vs expected ~3.8k. Can we triage before EOD? Summary below:

```
7/29 11:00-12:00 UTC  — tokens 1.2M  (baseline 750k)
Autoscale events: 2
Anomaly: high concurrency + long outputs
``` 

billing-bot: Automated alert: unusual token burn detected for customer=blue-marble. Flag: POSSIBLE_COMMIT_OVERSHOOT. Details: https://rbwrd.link/alerts/AM-1123 :warning:

raj_tam: looking into logs now. initial hunch: one session produced large streamed outputs, maybe a loop. can you attach the rollup query or a sample request?

tim_sre: infra check: latency and queueing spike 11:20-11:45 UTC. autoscaler scaled but queue depth hit threshold. Noted routing fallback to rwl/light-13b at 11:21 — that likely multiplied token count. I've temporarily pinned them to rwl/light-7b-quant which reduces per-response tokens.

maria_finance: FYI if burn stays at this level they'd eat through the monthly commit early. Commit remaining this quarter: $9,800. Recommend temporary rate-limits and a proactive advisory to the account. Also flag renewal risk if pattern repeats. :eyes:

emma_cs: Action items: 
- I'll ping BlueMarble PM to confirm whether they rolled out a new batch job. @raj_tam please share offending request samples. @tim_sre keep the routing pin until tomorrow morning. @maria_finance draft an advisory (soft tone) and attach spend projection. :thumbsup:

raj_tam: got one session sample (user_session=abc123) — repeated `generate()` calls in <30s producing long outputs. Patch in place to cap tokens per session at 5k. sample log:

```
[11:22:05] session=abc123 request_id=01E9 generate_tokens=12000 prompt_len=400
[11:22:06] session=abc123 request_id=01E9 repeated_call_count=12
```

tim_sre: after pin + token cap, token burn returned to expected range within 40m. I'm monitoring; will alert if it creeps back up. :white_check_mark:

emma_cs: Thanks team. I'll schedule a 15m sync with BlueMarble tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk through the advisory and confirm mitigation. Closing this thread unless new flags appear.
